verdict.rationale: Feitian ships companion software (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool), so a buyer could reasonably ask about telemetry opt-out, and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. On-device fingerprint matching is a different privacy property and does not count as an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
